newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo gold futures end firm, little impact from IMF.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo gold futures end firm, little impact from IMF.

text.p: Yen-denominated Tokyo gold futures ended thin Monday trade a tad firmer due to a weak yen, while spot gold was little changed during Asian hours, traders said.
News over the weekend that the IMF left open the question of gold sales had little impact on the gold market, but gold sentiment remained bearish, they said.
Gold prices ranged from unchanged to eight yen per gram firmer. Benchmark August was four yen up at 1,343 yen.
Spot gold was quoted at $380.30/60 per ounce at the Tokyo close, against $380.15/65 in New York on Friday.
